evals.name: signed-request-client
evals.prompt: 用 Python（requests，不要用官方 SDK 或 DEMO）写一个 e签宝 SaaS API V3 的客户端模块：AppId 和 AppSecret 从环境变量读，先连沙箱环境，用官方推荐的请求签名鉴权方式。写一个通用的请求方法，然后用它做两件事：1）按企业名称“杭州某某科技有限公司”查询机构认证信息，打印 orgId；2）撤销 signFlowId 为 429b1d300a63d7e4c0d 的签署流程，撤销原因“合同条款错误”。
evals.expected_output: 一个可运行的 Python 模块：沙箱 Base URL 为 https://smlopenapi.esign.cn；每个请求带 X-Tsign-Open-App-Id、X-Tsign-Open-Auth-Mode: Signature、毫秒 X-Tsign-Open-Ca-Timestamp、X-Tsign-Open-Ca-Signature、Accept、Content-Type、Content-MD5；签名为 Base64(HmacSHA256(AppSecret, 7 行换行拼接的待签名字符串))；GET 的 query 进入 PathAndParameters；以 code == 0 判断成功；分别调用 GET /v3/organizations/identity-info 和 POST /v3/sign-flow/{signFlowId}/revoke。
expectations: The base URL is https://smlopenapi.esign.cn (sandbox), with https://openapi.esign.cn mentioned or configurable for production
Every request sends X-Tsign-Open-App-Id, X-Tsign-Open-Auth-Mode with the exact value Signature, X-Tsign-Open-Ca-Timestamp as a millisecond Unix timestamp, and X-Tsign-Open-Ca-Signature

The string to sign is built as HTTPMethod + 
 + Accept + 
 + Content-MD5 + 
 + Content-Type + 
 + Date + 
 + PathAndParameters, keeping the empty Date line and not adding an extra line for empty Headers; it is not a sorted key=value parameter string
The signature is Base64 of the raw HmacSHA256 digest keyed with AppSecret, not a hex digest

Content-MD5 for a JSON body is Base64 of the raw 16-byte MD5 digest (not Base64 of the 32-char hex string), computed over exactly the same bytes that are sent; GET requests without a body use an empty Content-MD5 in the string to sign
Accept and Content-Type values used in the string to sign are identical to the header values actually sent (for example */* and application/json; charset=UTF-8)

The identity query is GET /v3/organizations/identity-info with orgName as a query parameter, and the query string appears in PathAndParameters without the host and without URL-encoding the value, while the actual request URL is properly encoded
The revoke call is POST /v3/sign-flow/429b1d300a63d7e4c0d/revoke with JSON body {"revokeReason": "合同条款错误"}
Success is judged by parsing the JSON and checking code == 0 (integer); the code parses the JSON body even on HTTP 401 and does not rely on the message text

evals.name: upload-and-send-for-signing
evals.prompt: 我们是企业自用的 HR 系统，对接 e签宝 SaaS API V3（沙箱）。本地有一份“劳动合同.pdf”，要让新员工签字，然后由我们公司（就是开放平台应用所属的企业）自动盖章，员工先签、公司后盖。员工只知道姓名和手机号，没在 e签宝认证过。签署链接由我们自己推送给员工，不需要 e签宝发短信。流程结束后我们要能下载签好的合同。请用 Python 写出从上传文件到拿到员工签署链接的完整代码（签名部分可以写成一个 helper）。
evals.expected_output: 代码先调 POST /v3/files/file-upload-url（文件 Content-MD5、application/pdf、带 .pdf 的文件名、文件大小）拿 fileId 和 fileUploadUrl，再用 PUT 把文件字节上传到 fileUploadUrl（Content-MD5/Content-Type 与第一步一致），然后轮询 GET /v3/files/{fileId} 直到 fileStatus 为 2 或 5；再调 POST /v3/sign-flow/create-by-file：员工为个人签署方（psnAccount + psnName）手动签，公司为机构签署方 autoSign=true 且不传 orgSignerInfo，按顺序签，autoFinish=true，不设置短信通知；最后调 POST /v3/sign-flow/{signFlowId}/sign-url 用员工手机号取签署链接。
expectations: Upload step 1 calls POST /v3/files/file-upload-url with contentMd5 = Base64(raw MD5 digest of the file bytes), contentType application/pdf (or application/octet-stream), a fileName ending in .pdf, and fileSize in bytes

Upload step 2 sends an HTTP PUT of the raw file bytes to data.fileUploadUrl with Content-MD5 and Content-Type headers identical to the values passed in step 1, and does not add the e签宝 X-Tsign-Open-* signature headers to this PUT

Before creating the sign flow the code polls GET /v3/files/{fileId} until data.fileStatus is 2 or 5 (with a delay between polls and a timeout), instead of assuming the file is ready after the PUT returns
The sign flow is created with POST /v3/sign-flow/create-by-file whose docs contain the uploaded fileId and whose signFlowConfig includes a signFlowTitle
The employee signer has signerType 0 and psnSignerInfo with psnAccount set to the phone number and psnInfo.psnName set to the name
The company signer has signerType 1 with normalSignFieldConfig.autoSign true and does not pass orgSignerInfo or transactorInfo
Signing order is set with signConfig.signOrder 1 for the employee and 2 for the company

Each signFields entry references the uploaded fileId and gives a position (signFieldPosition with positionPage, positionX, positionY, possibly obtained from the keyword-positions API) or uses an explicit alternative such as freeMode for the manual signer

The flow is set up so that it reaches the completed state and can be downloaded: autoFinish is true, or the code explicitly calls POST /v3/sign-flow/{signFlowId}/finish after all parties sign; autoStart is left at its default true or set true
No e签宝 SMS notification is requested: noticeTypes is left unset or empty rather than "1"
The signing link is fetched with POST /v3/sign-flow/{signFlowId}/sign-url passing operator.psnAccount equal to the employee phone number used at creation, and reads data.shortUrl or data.url
If signFlowExpireTime is set, it is a millisecond timestamp no more than 90 days in the future

evals.name: callback-verify-and-download
evals.prompt: 用 Python Flask 写一个 e签宝 SaaS API V3 的回调接收接口：我们在发起签署时把 notifyUrl 设成了 https://hr.example.com/esign/notify?tenant=acme 。收到回调要先确认这个请求确实来自 e签宝，只有当整个签署流程真正签署完成时，才把签好的合同下载保存到本地 contracts/{signFlowId}.pdf。AppSecret 从环境变量读。
evals.expected_output: Flask 路由读取原始请求体字节和 X-Tsign-Open-TIMESTAMP、X-Tsign-Open-SIGNATURE 头，按 hex(HmacSHA256(AppSecret, timestamp + 按 key 排序后的 query 值拼接（这里是 acme）+ 原始 body)) 验签；快速返回 2xx（建议 {"code":"200","msg":"success"}），下载放后台；处理 action == SIGN_FLOW_COMPLETE 且 signFlowStatus == "2"；通过签名请求 POST /v3/sign-flow/{signFlowId}/file-download-url 拿 downloadUrl 并及时下载；对重复推送幂等。
expectations: Signature verification uses the raw request body bytes (for example request.get_data()), not a re-serialized JSON object
The timestamp and signature are read from the X-Tsign-Open-TIMESTAMP and X-Tsign-Open-SIGNATURE headers (not X-Tsign-Open-Ca-Timestamp / X-Tsign-Open-Ca-Signature)
The signed data is timestamp + the callback URL query values concatenated in ascending key order (here the value acme, without key names or separators) + raw body, HMAC-SHA256 keyed with AppSecret
The computed signature is a lowercase hex digest compared (preferably with a constant-time compare) against the header value; it is not Base64 and it does not reuse the 7-line request string-to-sign
The handler returns an HTTP 2xx status quickly (the docs suggest within 5 seconds, body like {"code":"200","msg":"success"}) and performs the download asynchronously or after enqueueing

Only action SIGN_FLOW_COMPLETE with signFlowStatus equal to "2" (string, or compared after converting to int) triggers the download; revoked (3), expired (5) and refused (7) completions do not, and SIGN_MISSON_COMPLETE (per-signer result) is not treated as the whole flow being finished
Unknown or unhandled action values are acknowledged with 2xx and ignored
Duplicate deliveries (retries up to 16 times, or both Webhook and notifyUrl configured) are handled idempotently, for example by de-duplicating on signFlowId plus action

The contract is downloaded by a properly signed request to POST /v3/sign-flow/{signFlowId}/file-download-url (or the legacy GET), reading data.files[].downloadUrl and fetching it promptly because the link expires (default 3600 seconds)
